BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHIVJYOTI SAIKIA  ORDER 19.06.2023 Heard Mr. S. Ahmed, learned counsel representing the petitioner.
This is an application filed under Section 482 of the CrPC in respect of PRC Case No. 53/2021 corresponding to Gohpur Police Station Case No. 33/2019 under Sections 420/376/506/379/34 IPC.
Charge-sheet was filed by Police showing the petitioner as absconder.
Therefore, without issuing summon, trial court directly issued NBWA against the Page No.# 2/2 petitioner.

This is an application filed under Section 482 of the CrPC in respect of PRC Case No. 53/2021 corresponding to Gohpur Police Station Case No. 33/2019 under Sections 420/376/506/379/34 IPC.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: I find that the learned trial court failed to apply judicial mind while issuing the NBWA against the petitioner.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Therefore, the NBWA issued against the petitioner in connection with Gohpur Police Station Case No. 33/2019 under Sections 420/376/506/379/34 IPC by the Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Gohpur, Sonitpur is quashed.
Petitioner is directed to appear before the trial court on 19.07.2023 seeking bail.
On appearance of the petitioner, the trial court shall consider the bail application of the petitioner in accordance with law and pass necessary order.
The NBWA issued against the petitioner stands recalled.
The criminal petition is disposed of.
